29a8(mdo): dang /dga' ldan pa rnams dang /'phrul dga' ba rnams dang/gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnaMs la yang yod do //tshangs ris kyi lha rnams la ni pha yang myed ma yang myed /tshangs ris kyi lha rnams

29b2(mdo): yang yod do //byang gyi sgra myi snyan pa'i myi rnams la ni jo'o yang myed bran yang myed do //rgyal chen bzhi pa'i lha rnams la ni jo bo dang bran yang yod do //rgyal chen bzhi ba'i lha rnams ji lta ba bzhin
29b3(mdo): du /sum bcu rtsa gsum pa rnams dang /'thab bral ba rnams dang /dga' ldan pa rnams dang /'phrul dga' ba rnams dang /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa rnams la yang de bzhin no /tshangs 
29b4(mdo): ris kyi lha rnams la ni jo bo yang myed bran yang myed do//tshangs ris pa (rnaMs la)ji lta ba bzhin du /'og my-in gyi bar dag la yang de bzhin no /ji ltar 'dzam bu gling gyi spyi rnams la nor 
29b5(mdo): dang 'bru yod pa bzhin du /sharakyi lus 'phags pa rnams dang /nub kyi ban langaspyod pa rnams la yang yod do//byang gyi sgra myi snyan gyi myi rnams la ni 'bru ni yod la nor ni myed do //
29b6(mdo): rgyal chen bzhi pa'i lha rnamasal nor ni yod la 'bru ni myed do //rgyal chen bzhipa'i lha rnams la ji lta bu bzhin du /sum bcu rtsa gsum papa rnams dang /'thab bralapa rnams dang /dga' ldan pa rnaMs dang /
29b7(mdo): 'phrul dga' pa rnams dang /gzhan 'phruladabang byed pa rnams la yangade bzhin no //tshangs ris kyi lha rnams la ni nor dang myed 'bru yang myed do //tshangs ris pa rnams la ji lta ba bzhin du /'og
29b8(mdo): myin gyi bar dag la yang de bzhin no //ji ltar 'dzam bu gling gi myi rnams la pha 'am /ma 'am bu pho 'am /jo bo 'am /bran nam /nor 'am /'bru la mngon par zhen pa yod pa bzhin du /
30a1(mdo): //shar kyi lus 'phags pa rnams dang /nub kyi ban glang spyod pa rnams yod do //byang gyi sgra myi snyan gyi myi rnams ni ci la yang mngon par zhen pa myed do //rgyal chen bzhi'i lha rnams ni 'bru ma gtogs 
30a2(mdo): pa rnams la mngon par zhen pa yod do //rgyal chen bzhi'i lta rnams ji lta ba bzhin du /sum bcu rtsa gsum pa rnams dang /'thab bral ba rnams dang /dga' ldan pa rnams dang /'phrul dga' ba rnams dang /

30a4(mdo): pa chen po pa rnams dang /'od chung ba rnams dang /tshad myed 'od pa rnams dang /'od gsal ba rnams dang /dge' chung ba rnams dang /tshang myed dge' ba rnams dang /dge' rgyas pa rnams dang /
30a5(mdo): bsod nams skyes pa rnams dang /'bras bu che ba rnams dang /myi che ba rnams dang /myi gdung ba rnams dang /gya nom snang ba rnaMs dang /shin tu mthong ba rnams dang /'og myin gyi lha rnaMs kyang
30a6(mdo): de bzhin no //'jig rten gdags pa las tshigs lnga pa'o //sdom ni /zla mtshan 'khrig dang khu chu da /tshe dang nag po chu klung brag /sa la rdzing dang glang po dang /srungs ma 'khor los sgyur ba'i lam /ji ltar 'dzam
30a7(mdo): bu gling gi myi rnams la /bud myed zla mtshan can dang /sbrum ma dang /bu btsa ba yod pa bzhin du /shar kyi lus 'phags pa rnams dang /nub kyi ban lang spyod pa rnams dang /byang gyi sgra myi snyan pa rnams la yang 
30a8(mdo): yod do //rgyal chen bzhi pa'i lha rnams kyi ni /'dzam bu gling gi myi rnams kyi khye'u mo lo lnga lon pa ji tsam ba de bzhin du /lha 'am lha'i bu mo'i phrag pa 'am pang par sems can rdzus te skye bar 'byung bar 'gyur de /
30b1(mdo): de na lha 'am lha'i bu mo dag 'di snyam du /'di ni bdag gi bu 'am bu mo snyam du sems so //khye'u dang bu mo de dag kyang 'di snyam du /'di ni bdag cag gi ma 'am pa'o snyam du sems so //sum bcu rtsa 
30b2(mdo): gsum pa rnams kyi ni /lo drug lon pa ji tsam pa bzhin no //'thab bral ba rnams kyi ni lo bdun lon pa ji tsam pa bzhin no //dga' ldan pa rnams kyi ni lo brgyad lon pa ci tsam pa bzhin no //'phrul 
30b3(mdo): dga' ba rnams kyi ni lo dgu lon pa ji tsam pa bzhin //gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa rnams kyi ni /'dzam bu gling gi myi rnams kyi khye'u dang bu mo lo bcu lon pa ji tsam pa de bzhin du /lha 'am 
30b4(mdo): lha'i bu mo'i phrag pa 'am pang par rdzus te skye ba'i sems can 'byung bar 'gyur te /de na lha 'am lha'i bu mo dag 'di snyam du 'di ni bdag gi bu 'am bu mo snyam du sems so //khye'u 
30b5(mdo): dang bu mo de dag kyang 'disnyam du 'di bdag cag gi ma 'am pha'o snyam du sems so /tshangs ris kyi lha rnams ni thog ma nyid nas yan lag dang nying lag thams cad rdzogs par skye zhing 'chi ba na 
30b6(mdo): yang de kho na bzhin no //tshangs ris kyi lha rnams ji lta bu bzhin du /'og myin gyi bar dag kyang de bzhin no //gzugs myed pa rnams ni lus kyi gzugs myed do //de nas ni de dag skye bar yang myi mngon /
30b7(mdo): 'chi ba yang myi mngon no //ji ltar 'dzam bu gling gi myi rnams myi tshangs par spyod pa'i 'khrig pa'i chos bsten pa ni /gnyis kyi gnyis sbyor ba yod pa bzhin du /shar kyi lus 'phags pa rnams dang /
30b8(mdo): nub kyi ban glang spyod pa rnams dang /byang gyi sgra myi snyan pa rnams dang /rgyal chen bzhi pa'i lha rnams dang /sum bcu rtsa gsum pa rnams kyang de bzhin no //'thab bral ba rnams 'khyud pa tsam gyis 
31a1(mdo): //gdung ba zhi bar 'gyur ro //dga' ldan pa rnams kyi ni lag pa nas bzung ba tsam gyis so //'phrul dga' ba rnams kyis ni bgod pa tsam gyis so //gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa 
31a2(mdo): rnams kyi ni bltas pa tsam gyis gdung ba zhi bar 'gyur ro//tshangs ris pa rnams ni 'dod chags myed do //tshangs ris pa rnams ji lta ba bzhin du /'og myin gyi bar dag kyang de bzhin no //
31a3(mdo): ji ltar 'dzam bu gling gi myi rnams la khu chu myi rtsad pa yod pa 'byung ba bzhin du /shar kyi lus 'phags pa rnams dang /nub kyi ban lang spyod pa rnams dang /byang gyi sgra myi snyan pa rnams 
31a4(mdo): la yang de bzhin no //rgyal chen bzhi'i lha rnams kyi ni rlung 'byung ngo //rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams kyi ji lta ba bzhin du /sum bcu rtsa gsum pa rnams dang /'thab 
31a5(mdo): 'bral ba rnams dang /dga' ldan pa rnams dang /'phrul dga' ba rnams dang /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa rnams kyi de bzhin no //tshangs ris kyi lha rnams la 'dod chags myed do 
31a6(mdo): tshangs ris pa rnams ji ltar ba bzhin du /'og myin gi bar dag kyang de bzhin //sems can dmyal ba pa'i sems can rnams kyi tshe'i tshad kyi rab ni bskal pa gcig ste /bar ma dor 'tshe ba ni yod 
31a7(mdo): do //dud 'gro'i skye gnas su skyes pa'i sems can rnams kyis rab ni bskal pa gcig ste/bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do //myi rnams kyi nyin zhag sum bcu gang yin pa de ni yi dgas rnams kyi nyin 
31a8(mdo): zhag gcig ste /nyin zhag sum bcu la zla ba gcig /zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcig ste /yid dgas rnams kyi tshe'i tshad kyi rang ni lnga brgya ste /bar ma dor 'chi ba yod do //myi'i ltar brtsi na lo 
31b1(mdo): khri lnga stong yod do //shar kyi lus 'phags kyi myi rnams kyi tshe'i tshad kyi rab ni /lo nyis brgya lnga bcu ste bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do //nub kyi ban lang spyod kyi myi rnams kyi tshe'i tshad  kyi rab ni

31b3(mdo): myed ce na /de dag la bdag gi ba myed cing yongs su 'dzin pa myed de /tshe des shing khyad par du 'gro bas /de'i phyir byang gi sgra myi snyan kyi mi rnams la bar ma dor 'tshi ba myed do //'dzam bu gling
31b4(mdo): gi myi rnams la ni yar skye ba dang mar 'grib pa yod do //'dzam bu gling gi myi rnams res 'ag ni tshe dpag tu myed par 'gyur //res 'ag ni tshe lo bcu par 'gyur ro //myi rnams 
31b5(mdo): kyi lo lnga bcu gang yin pa de ni /rgyal chen bzhi pa'i lha rnams kyi nyin zhag gcig go //nyin zhag de sum bcu la zla ba gcig zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcig ste /rgyal chen bzhi pa'i lha
31b6(mdo): rnams kyi tshe'i tshad kyi rab ni lha'i lo lnga brgya ste bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do //de myi ltar brtsi na lo sa ya phrag dgu yod do //de'i sems can dmyal ba chen po yang sos kyi nyin zhag gcig go//
31b7(mdo): nyin zhag sum bcu la zla ba gcig/zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcis ste /sems can dmyal ba yang sos kyi sems can rnams kyi tshe'i tshad kyi rab  ni /sems can dmyal ba ba'i lo lnga brgya ste /bar ma dor

32a1(mdo): //nyin zhag de sum bcu la zla ba gcig /zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcig ste /sum bcu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams kyi tshe'i tshad kyi rab ni lha'i lo stong ste /bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do /
32a2(mdo): de myi'i ltar brtsi na lo bye ba phrag gsum dang /sa ya phrag drug yod do //de ni sems can dmyal ba chen po thig nag gi nyin zhag gcig go //nyin zhag de sum bcu lazla ba gcig go //

32b1(mdo): nyin zhag de sum bcu la zla ba gcig /zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcig ste /dga' ldan gi lha rnams kyi tshe'i tshad kyi rab ni lha'i lo bzhi stong ste /bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do //de myi'i ltar

34b1(mdo): 'di ltar 'bab po //gang ga ni shar phyogs nas klang po che'i kha nas 'bab ste /de ni mtsho chen po chu zhes bya ba la g.yas phyogs su bskor nas /klung lha brgya dang lhan cig du shar phyogs kyi rgya
